name: Waymo Open Dataset
description: A large-scale autonomous driving dataset containing high-resolution sensor data, including camera images and LiDAR, with annotated driving scenes. This record is loader-only and does not distribute dataset files.
citation: Sun, P., Kretzschmar, H., Dotiwalla, X., et al. (2020). Scalability in Perception for Autonomous Driving: Waymo Open Dataset. Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR), 2446–2454. https://doi.org/10.1109/CVPR42600.2020.00252
